title: Powerbond
summary: The Powerbond is a rare and advanced form of synchronization between a Titan and their Seeker. When the bond between a Seeker and their Titan reaches extraordinary strength, the Titan can become Powerbonded, transforming in appearance and gaining enhanced powers, new abilities, and perfect telepathic communication with its Seeker. Historically an incredibly rare phenomenon, the occurrence of Powerbonded Titans appears to be increasing among the new generation of Seekers.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Across history, it was extremely rare to encounter a Powerbonded Titan. [Cave of the Casterwills] In the modern age, knowledge of the Powerbond was widespread amongst Seekers including Nimue Casterwill [S2E29], Dante Vale [S2E27], and Tantras who knew that the mechanics of its power and abilities were not to be underestimated. [S2E36]

At some point in the 16th century, Nostradamus formed a Powerbond with his Titan, Sorcerel. Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill encountered her when they were sent back in time by Kronos and fought with Nostradamus and Viktor Casterwill. Sophie, who had acquired the same Sorcerel herself but centuries later, was surprised to see a Powerbonded version of her. [HM17]

 for the first time]]
Lok Lambert first discovered the Powerbond power while searching for his father’s last known whereabouts in Peru, a mission of significant emotional importance to him. Upon summoning Kipperin, he was surprised to find that the Titan had drastically changed upon invocation, merging with him to form one body. Dante Vale then explained that, because his bond to his father's Titan was so strong, they had become Powerbonded. Later, Lok Powerbonded with Baselaird, to save Dante and Zhalia from Wilder and The Organization. [S2E27]

In the Crystal Caves, Sophie Casterwill was able to empower and invoke the spirit of Sabriel despite Sabriel’s Amulet having been destroyed. This was made possible in part by the presence of Sorcerel, Sabriel’s sister and a kindred spirit, who was resting within the Crystal Caves and with whom Sophie was actively attempting to form a bond. Through this connection, Sophie was able to reestablish a connection with Sabriel’s spirit and Powerbond with her, bypassing the traditional requirement of an Amulet. Throughout these events, residual energy associated with Sabriel was shown lingering around Sophie’s hand within the caves, indicating an ongoing connection that ultimately culminated in the formation of the Powerbond. [S2E29]

Dante Vale invoked the Powerbond with Caliban in a last effort to save himself from Rassimov and the Blood Spiral in Klaus' bookshop, with Powerbonded Caliban’s martial arts abilities helping to even the battle and give the team an opportunity to escape. [S2E32]
 while under attack from Arc]]
In order to protect Lok from the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc, Lindorm became Powerbonded with him. [S2E34] 

When Zhalia Moon was discovered infiltrating the Blood Spiral by Tantras, Gareon became Powerbonded with her and used his Scramblemind ability to erase Tantras’ memory of her being a double agent. [S2E39]

When Sophie Casterwill was fighting against Kiel at the Fortress of Iron Will, she Powerbonded with Sorcerel, thus regaining her strength to fight Kiel. [S2E40]

When the Blood Spiral travelled to the Castle of Vlad Dracul, Harrison Fears managed to bond with the vampiric Antedeluvian and then Powerbond with him, at an exceptionally rapid pace. [S2E43] 
]]

Breaker became Powerbonded to Grier during a battle in the Professor's castle in order to save him from asphyxiation at the hands Wilder's Grand Façade, much to the amazement of Den Fears. Powerbonded Breaker then defeated Grand Façade with his "Crushing Grip" power. [S2E46]

In Egypt, Dante became Powerbonded to Ariel while under attack from Rassimov and the Legendary Titan of War, Legion. Dante intended for Ariel to get his team to safety, while he led Rassimov away with the Necklace of Tutankhamun. However, Solwing snatched the Necklace himself, leading Rassimov and Legion away and saving Dante. Powerbonded Ariel stopped Dante from going after him and reminded him to save the team. [S2E47]
, the first known Legendary Titan to Powerbond]]
At the Blood Spiral Base, after faltering during his final battle with his brother, Harrison, Den Fears sensed Vigilante becoming Powerbonded, reminding him that him not to let his friends down. After invoking Powerbonded Vigilante, Den merged with him using his new "Cindercloak" ability and fought and defeated Powerbonded Antedeluvian. Before he could defeat Harrison however, Vigilante was disrupted by falling rocks and sent back to his Amulet. [S2E51]

During the final battle with the Betrayer, Pendragon's Amulet independently emerged from the Willblade to save Lok from Demigorgan, the Titan of Betrayal. Pendragon was then revealed to have become Powerbonded, defeating the Titan copies of Sabriel, Raijin and Gareon created by Demigorgan. [S2E52]

sections.heading: Process
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E32 Dante pain.png|thumb|Dante's struggle to save himself results in him powerbonding with [[Caliban]]]]
While the context and situation of a Powerbond is different for every Seeker and their Titan, the process often consists of these stages:
# '''Strong Bond''' - The Titan and Seeker must develop deep mutual trust and synchronization.
# '''Emotional Growth''' - Often triggered by heightened stakes, emotional struggle, or shared hardship.
# '''Transformation''' - Physically and spiritually, the Titan transforms into its Powerbonded form, revealing enhanced abilities and sometimes new combat forms.
# '''Shared Abilities''' - In some cases, the Seeker may gain shared or complementary abilities that augment their combat synergy.

sections.heading: Exceptions and Variations
sections.text:
means she can be summoned from her hand]]
In exceptional circumstances, the Powerbond can bypass the requirement of an Amulet, seen in the case of Sabriel whose bond with Sophie Casterwill was so strong that, despite her Amulet being destroyed, Sophie was able to reestablish a connection with Sabriel’s spirit and Powerbond with her, now summoning her from her hand. This anomaly was made possible in part by the presence of Sorcerel, Sabriel’s sister, who was resting within the Crystal Caves and with whom Sophie was actively attempting to form a bond. [S2E29] 

The formation of a Powerbond may also occur far more rapidly in rare cases of extreme compatibility. Harrison Fears summoned Antedeluvian in his Powerbonded form only shortly after acquiring his Amulet, suggesting that a Powerbond can be established almost instantaneously when a Seeker’s disposition significantly aligns with a Titan’s nature, particularly where a Seeker’s personality is similar to a Titan’s previous Seeker, as Harrison was to Vlad Dracul. [S2E43]

sections.heading: Characteristics
sections.text:
gains an additional pair of arms and a second tail]]
Upon their transformation, Powerbonded Titans typically gain golden or gilded armor, often covering areas that were previously unarmoured or less defined. This is frequently accompanied by an increased physical stature, with some Titans appearing larger or more imposing than their original forms, seen significantly in the cases of Baselaird and Gareon. [S2E39] Another defining feature is the appearance of a gem embedded in the centre of the chest, [Doorway to Huntik] which visually corresponds to gem on the Titan's Amulet, which itself signifies their Titan type. [Huntik.com] In some cases, the Powerbond can result in more dramatic anatomical changes. Lindorm developed an additional pair of arms and a second tail, increasing his total number of limbs and altering his physical form. [S2E34]

A Powerbond also establishes an exceptionally strong empathic link between the Seeker and Titan. As a result, when a Seeker is injured, their Powerbonded Titan may experience or react to the Seeker’s pain, reflecting the depth of their synchronization. This effect was seen when Lok Lambert was struck by a Poisonfang power, with his Titan Baselaird also experiencing the effects and becoming temporarily stunned. [S2E28]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
and a Suit in perfect sync]]
Powerbonded Titans display significantly enhanced combat skills, including increased offensive and defensive capabilities, as well as the manifestation of new abilities made possible through heightened mental and physical synchronization with their Seeker. These abilities are typically in direct coordination with the Powerbonded Titan, as demonstrated by Dante Vale and Caliban’s "Mirror Fight", Zhalia Moon and Gareon’s "Scramblemind", and Lok Lambert and Lindorm’s "Spinnerslash". [S2E36] 

Powerbonded Titans are composed of a distinct form of Powerbonded energy. In the case of Baselaird, this energy could be transferred to his Seeker, allowing Lok Lambert to enhance his own abilities through the technique known as "Focus Blade". [S2E45] 

In some cases, Powerbonding enables a Titan and Seeker to temporarily merge into a single combined entity, acting as one both physically and mentally. This was demonstrated by Lok Lambert and Kipperin with the "Winged Fusion" ability [S2E27] as well as Den Fears and Vigilante through the "Cindercloak" ability, representing most extreme manifestations of Seeker–Titan synchronization. [S2E51]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* In the original Italian version and a few other dubs, Powerbonded Titans are voiced and reply outloud to their Seeker's orders. In the English dub however, Powerbonded Titans are mute.
* According to Huntik Magazine Issue 18’s crossword game, the Powerbond is defined as “the power that strengthens the bond between a Seeker and their Titan”.
